summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the Textual repo without running tests or committing. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs with reactive state, synchronous on_key, click dispatch via range_clicked metadata, animated bar watcher); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges before width and yields one Text object with click spans last; Opacity now merges blended colour into the existing style so metadata is preserved; the layout resolver needed no change because Edge already declares min_size. Added docs/reference/tabs.md, sandbox/tabs_demo.py and .css, appended new tests to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py, and added tests/test_tabs.py. Deviations to review: bar position uses the displayed index rather than the full-list find_tab_by_name index so duplicate names still underline the displayed active tab; can_focus=True was added so key events reach the widget; name and id were appended as extra constructor arguments; letter search applies only to single-character keys; Escape makes the specified un-awaited set_focus call, which emits a coroutine warning and does not remove focus.
